sentence: When the BPD splitting happens, she can go from worshipping me to hating me, first in private and than in front of everybody.
If I’m supposed to glisten to everything on her mind, I don’t want to have to pretend they aren’t on mine.
On the other hand, in a polyamorous relationship, the boundaries might be more negotiable, but then somebody has to sit down and negotiate them, down to who gets to stray the night.
